 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = grid[0][0]
    marker = 2
    ink = 8
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == marker for c in range(w))]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(h))]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, marker)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if rows:
        rline = rows[0]
        # The object lies on one side of the marker; continue beyond it with a line.
        side = 1 if min(r for r, c in cells) > rline else -1
        rr = (max(r for r, c in cells) + 1) if side == 1 else (min(r for r, c in cells) - 1)
        if 0 <= rr < h:
            out[rr] = [ink] * w
    elif cols:
        cline = cols[0]
        side = 1 if min(c for r, c in cells) > cline else -1
        cc = (max(c for r, c in cells) + 1) if side == 1 else (min(c for r, c in cells) - 1)
        if 0 <= cc < w:
            for r in range(h):
                out[r][cc] = ink
    return out
"
}
